simplifications: Three podium/shaft extents and mechanical enclosure follow the site-plan outline and labelled level elevations.

simplifications: Original four registered core boxes and all labelled level elevations retained.
South facade proportions manually interpreted from A4.00 raster elevation; 1.50m balcony projection from A1.00 written dimension.
Unshown elevations, minor podium recesses and interior parking ramps remain omitted. Shallow visible deck-edge bands do not model interior ramps.
Exact thickness, guard height, fine counts and PBR finish values are display approximations.
newValues.modelFidelity: Preserved registered envelope with A4.00 south frame groups, separate balconies, material hierarchy and source-visible podium treatment
newValues.geometryCoverage: Only the supplied south elevation and short front returns detailed. Other elevations remain schematic.
newValues.credit: Design reference: Kohn Partnership Architects / City of Mississauga. Independent authored model: Daniel Sultan / Future Mississauga.
newValues.modelCaveat: Source-informed south facade and podium study based on Kohn drawings dated July 30, 2026. The registered core and labelled floor/roof levels are retained. Other elevations remain schematic. Bay widths, minor relief, guards, slab thickness and finishes are illustrative. Inherited placement has a working +/-2 m horizontal allowance; architectural ASL minus70 datum compatibility is not independently certified. Proposed application-stage design, not as-built.
